name: W.O.M.A.N., Inc.
description: 24-hour crisis support, therapy, peer counseling, and Spanish-language services
fullDescription: W.O.M.A.N., Inc. has served San Francisco and the Bay Area since 1978, providing a 24-hour support line, therapy, peer counseling, support groups, and case management for survivors of domestic violence.
whatTheyOffer:
- 24-hour support line for counseling, safety planning, and referrals
- Individual and family therapy (English and Spanish)
- Peer counseling and support groups
- Latinx Program with case management for Spanish-speaking survivors
- Safety planning
- Referrals to resources
howToGetIt:
1. Call the toll-free 24-hour support line: 877-384-3578
2. Latinx Program: email citas@womaninc.org
3. Office: 415-864-4777
4. Peer counseling may have a waitlist; call the hotline for immediate support
5. All services confidential
keywords: WOMAN Inc, San Francisco, domestic violence, crisis intervention, counseling, therapy, peer counseling, support groups, Latinx program, Spanish, 24/7 hotline, 877-384-3578
